response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS fundflux, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS project_count FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), t AS (SELECT SUM(project_count) AS total, AVG(project_count) AS avg_count FROM c) SELECT c.fundflux, c.project_count, c.project_count * 1.0 / t.total AS share, c.project_count - t.avg_count AS excess_over_average FROM c CROSS JOIN t WHERE c.project_count > t.avg_count

assumptions.assumption: Projects with a NULL fundflux are treated as their own funding-source group, so they count toward the total and the average and can appear in the output. If no project has a NULL fundflux, this has no effect.
The average is the plain mean of the per-source distinct project counts, and share is count divided by the sum of those counts, computed as a decimal with no rounding.

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude projects with a NULL funding source, so only real funding sources count toward the total and the average.
alternatives.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS fundflux, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS project_count FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref WHERE p.fundflux IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.fundflux), t AS (SELECT SUM(project_count) AS total, AVG(project_count) AS avg_count FROM c) SELECT c.fundflux, c.project_count, c.project_count * 1.0 / t.total AS share, c.project_count - t.avg_count AS excess_over_average FROM c CROSS JOIN t WHERE c.project_count > t.avg_count
